name: Absorption Flow scatters original work through saved Free Cities carrier and reaches RESULT

condition.code: return JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI~=nil and not Controls.OpenButton:IsHidden() and ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetPending(Game.GetLocalPlayer())~=nil

steps.code:
local panel=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI)
assert(panel.Open() and not Controls.Panel:IsHidden(),'human native scatter choice panel did not open')
local first=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetPending(Game.GetLocalPlayer()))
assert(first.ID=='native-scatter-flow' and first.Phase=='CHOICE','wrong pending native scatter flow')
local sent={}
local function nextChoice()
 local flow=ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetPending(Game.GetLocalPlayer())
 if not flow or flow.Phase~='CHOICE' then return end
 for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries or {}) do
  if not entry.EscapeOutcome and not entry.SelectedAction then
   if sent[entry.ID] then return end
   assert(panel.SelectEntry(entry.ID),'could not select '..entry.ID)
   local action=entry.Kind=='UNIT' and 'INCORPORATE'
     or entry.Kind=='PERSON' and 'RECRUIT'
     or entry.Kind=='HERO' and 'RECONTRACT'
     or entry.Kind=='GREAT_PERSON' and 'RECRUIT'
     or entry.Kind=='ITEM' and 'TRANSFER'
     or entry.Kind=='UNLOCK' and 'INHERIT' or 'PRESERVE'
   assert(panel.ChooseAction(action),'real UI rejected '..entry.ID..'/'..action)
   sent[entry.ID]=true
   return
  end
 end
end
Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Add(nextChoice)
nextChoice()
return 'human native scatter selections started through the real panel'

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local flow=assert(F.Get('native-scatter-flow'))
local baseline=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW'))
assert(flow.Phase=='CHOICE' and flow.Phase1Complete,'scatter choice phase changed before confirmation')
local n=0
for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries or {}) do
 if entry.ID=='native-work:'..baseline.WorkIndex then
  n=n+1
  assert(entry.EscapeOutcome=='SCATTER' and not entry.SelectedAction,'escaped original work was chosen again')
  assert(A.Rules.Equal(entry.Rolls,baseline.Rolls),'original work was rerolled')
 elseif not entry.EscapeOutcome then assert(entry.SelectedAction,'surviving asset lacks a UI choice') end
end
assert(n==1,'original work missing or duplicated in saved Flow')
assert(#A.NativeWorkLocations(baseline.WorkIndex)==1,'choice phase moved original work early')
return 'all surviving assets selected and scattered work roll unchanged'

local panel=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI)
local view=panel.GetView()
assert(view.phase=='CHOICE' and view.canResolve and not Controls.ConfirmButton:IsDisabled(),'scatter confirmation control not ready')
Controls.ConfirmButton:DoLeftClick()
return 'human clicked the real scatter Flow confirm control'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local expected=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW'))
local flow=assert(F.Get(expected.ID))
assert(flow.Phase~='BLOCKED','carrier Flow blocked before stage save: '..tostring(flow.Error))
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[expected.ID],'carrier transaction not prepared')
local snap
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do if work.Source.Index==expected.WorkIndex then snap=work;break end end
assert(snap and snap.Outcome=='SCATTER' and snap.Custodian==expected.Free and snap.Carrier and snap.Carrier.Route=='TO_FREE','native scatter carrier intent absent')
assert(not snap.DealSubmitted and not tx.NativeDealUI,'unsafe direct AI-to-Free Cities Core deal was used')
local carrier=snap.Carrier
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(carrier.X,carrier.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==carrier.Owner or city:GetOwner()==carrier.Borrower,'carrier borrowed by another owner')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_CARRIER_STAGE] phase='..carrier.Phase..' cityOwner='..city:GetOwner()..' status='..tx.Status..' flow='..flow.Phase)
return 'scatter carrier intent saved; final physical proof remains required'

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local expected=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW'))
local flow=assert(F.Get(expected.ID))
assert(flow.Phase=='RESULT','native scatter Flow did not reach RESULT: '..tostring(flow.Error))
local escaped
for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries or {}) do
 if entry.ID=='native-work:'..expected.WorkIndex then escaped=entry;break end
end
assert(escaped and escaped.EscapeOutcome=='SCATTER'
 and A.Rules.Equal(escaped.Rolls,expected.Rolls),'P1 original scatter result or saved rolls changed')
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[expected.ID])
assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE','native scatter product transaction incomplete: '..tx.Status)
local snap
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do if work.Source.Index==expected.WorkIndex then snap=work;break end end
assert(snap and snap.PhysicalMoved and snap.Carrier and snap.Carrier.Phase=='PROVED','original scatter carrier not physically proved')
local actual=A.NativeWorkLocations(expected.WorkIndex)
assert(#actual==1,'original scattered work index missing or duplicated')
local w=actual[1];local slot=snap.TargetSlot
assert(w.Owner==expected.Free and w.Owner==slot.Owner and w.CityID==slot.City and w.X==slot.X and w.Y==slot.Y and w.Building==slot.Building and w.Slot==slot.Slot,'original work missed final Free Cities exact slot')
assert(slot.X==expected.FreeSlot.X and slot.Y==expected.FreeSlot.Y and slot.Building==expected.FreeSlot.Building and slot.Slot==expected.FreeSlot.Slot,'different Free Cities carrier was used')
for _,key in ipairs({'GreatWorkType','ObjectType','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do assert(expected.Source[key]==w[key],'original scattered metadata changed: '..key) end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(expected.Source.Effects,w.Effects),'original scattered effects changed')
local old=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(expected.Source.X,expected.Source.Y))
assert(old:GetOwner()==tx.To,'old source city not transferred to absorber')
local current=A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(tx.To)
for _,work in ipairs(current) do assert(work.Index~=expected.WorkIndex,'scattered work remained with absorber') end
for _,city in ipairs(tx.Cities or {}) do assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(city.X,city.Y):GetOwner()==tx.To,'old AI city not absorbed') end
assert(Players[tx.From]:GetCities():GetCount()==0,'old faction still owns cities')
local archived=assert(A.GetState().Archive['native-work:'..expected.WorkIndex])
assert(archived.Owner==-1 and archived.Outcome=='SCATTER' and archived.NativeWork.Index==w.Index and archived.NativeCustody.Owner==w.Owner and archived.NativeCustody.City==w.CityID and archived.NativeCustody.Building==w.Building and archived.NativeCustody.Slot==w.Slot,'scatter archive differs from physical work')
assert(A.GetRoster(tx.To)['native-work:'..expected.WorkIndex]==nil,'absorber incorrectly holds scattered work')
local world=assert(F.GetWorld(expected.ID..':native-work:'..expected.WorkIndex),'world reward entry absent')
assert(world.AssetID=='native-work:'..expected.WorkIndex,'world reward points to another asset')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_RESULT] index='..w.Index..' owner='..w.Owner..' city='..w.CityID..' building='..w.Building..' slot='..w.Slot..' cities='..#tx.Cities..' world='..world.Status)
return 'Flow RESULT; same original index archived in exact Free Cities Temple'
